Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `HexTest.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/local_workplace/commons-codec/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/codec/binary/HexTest.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

I've analyzed both files. The test is well-structured but has repeated "magic" literals (the `"Hello World"` string and its hex encodings, the 72-character zero string) and some local-variable names that could be clearer. I'll introduce named constants and clarifying comments without changing any method calls, arguments, or expected outcomes.Now let me compile-check the improved test.The improved `HexTest.java` compiles successfully (`COMPILE_OK`). I enhanced readability by extracting repeated magic literals into named constants (`HELLO_WORLD`, `HELLO_WORLD_HEX_LOWER`, `HELLO_WORLD_HEX_UPPER`, `THIRTY_SIX_ZERO_BYTES_HEX`) and adding clarifying comments to the sliding-window buffer loops and case-sensitivity assertions—without changing any method calls, arguments, or expected outcomes.
